quests.title: A Strange Silence
text: [Draft] The birds stopped singing the night you arrived. The villagers say the old forest spirits have gone quiet.
Ask around: someone must know what happened.

quests.title: The Old Cleric

lines: You hear it too, don't you? The quiet.
The spirits sleep in the old groves. Bring me something that still remembers them: a sprig of glow berries from the caves below.

text: [Draft] The cleric wants glow berries from the lush caves.
